# Gcore AI

> Gcore AI documentation covers Everywhere Inference for edge model deployment and GPU Cloud for accelerated training and fine-tuning.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai.md): Gcore AI documentation covers Everywhere Inference for edge model deployment and GPU Cloud for accelerated training and fine-tuning.
- [Getting started](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/getting-started.md): Get started with Gcore AI by training models on GPU Cloud and deploying them for inference with Everywhere Inference.
- [Billing](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/billing.md): Gcore GPU and Everywhere Inference billing rules, including per-minute charges and monthly payment processing.

## Everywhere Inference
- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference.md): Gcore Everywhere Inference deploys AI models on edge nodes worldwide for low latency with smart routing and supported GPU flavors.
- [Application Catalog](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/application-catalog.md): Browse and deploy pre-built open-source AI models from the Gcore Everywhere Inference Application Catalog, grouped by category.

## AI models
- [Deploy a model from the Application Catalog](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/ai-models/deploy-from-catalog.md): Deploy pre-built open-source AI models from the Application Catalog by selecting regions, flavors, and pods.
- [Prepare a custom AI model for deployment](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/ai-models/prepare-a-custom-ai-model-for-deployment.md): Package a custom AI model into a container image with vLLM or Diffusers, push it to a registry, and deploy it for inference.
- [Deploy a custom model](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/ai-models/deploy-a-custom-model.md): Deploy a custom model with a Docker container image, configure pods, routing, autoscaling, and health checks.
- [Manage AI model deployments](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/ai-models/manage-ai-model-deployments.md): Manage AI model deployments in Everywhere Inference, including monitoring, logs, settings, and deletion.
- [Query a deployed model](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/ai-models/query-deployed-model.md): Send OpenAI-compatible chat completion requests to a deployed model via its HTTPS endpoint, with streaming and multi-turn history.
- [Chat with a model via Open WebUI](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/ai-models/chat-with-open-webui.md): Deploy a model with Open WebUI enabled, get the interface URL, create an admin account, and start chatting with the model.
- [Translate text with Llama 3.2](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/ai-models/translate-text-with-llama.md): Translate text with Llama 3.2 on Gcore Everywhere Inference using prompt patterns for single and multi-language output.

## Container image registries
- [Add a container image registry](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/container-image-registries/add-a-registry.md): Add a container image registry in Everywhere Inference to store private registry credentials for pulling Docker images.
- [Manage container image registries](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/container-image-registries/manage-registries.md): Add, edit, and delete container image registries and their credentials for pulling private images in Gcore deployments.

## API keys
- [Inference deployment with API key authentication](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/api-keys/create-inference-deployment-with-auth.md): Create authentication keys and enable key authentication to restrict access to Gcore Everywhere Inference deployments.

## Quotas
- [Request a quota increase](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/quotas/request-quota-increase.md): Submit a quota increase request for Everywhere Inference by selecting resources in Quotas Viewer and tracking status in request history.
- [Quotas Request History](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/everywhere-inference/quotas/quotas-request-history.md): Review the history and statuses of quota increase requests for Everywhere Inference resources.

## GPU Cloud
- [About GPU Cloud](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/ai-infrastructure/about-gpu-cloud.md): GPU Cloud offers dedicated GPU clusters for AI training, inference, and HPC with bare metal, spot, and virtual configurations.
- [Create a Virtual GPU cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/ai-infrastructure/create-a-virtual-gpu-cluster.md): Create a Virtual GPU cluster in Gcore GPU Cloud with virtual machines that have dedicated GPU access for AI training and inference.
- [Manage a Virtual GPU cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/ai-infrastructure/manage-a-virtual-gpu-cluster.md): Manage a Virtual GPU cluster by monitoring nodes, controlling power state, adding disks and network interfaces, and deleting resources.
- [Create a Bare Metal GPU cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/ai-infrastructure/create-a-bare-metal-gpu-cluster.md): Create a Bare Metal GPU cluster with dedicated GPU servers for AI training, inference, and distributed workloads.
- [Manage a Bare Metal GPU cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/ai-infrastructure/manage-a-bare-metal-gpu-cluster.md): Manage a Bare Metal GPU cluster by viewing nodes, resizing, reconfiguring, powering, rebuilding, replacing, and deleting nodes.
- [Spot Bare Metal GPU](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/ai-infrastructure/spot-bare-metal-gpu.md): Discounted GPU servers on unused capacity that can be reclaimed with 24 hours notice, suited to batch jobs and testing.

## Storage
- [Create and manage volumes](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/storage/create-and-manage-volumes.md): Create, attach, detach, resize, and delete persistent block storage volumes for GPU cluster nodes.
- [Create and manage file shares](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/storage/create-and-manage-file-shares.md): Create, mount, resize, and delete VAST file shares for high-performance shared NFS storage on GPU cluster nodes.

## Networking
- [About GPU Cloud networking](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/networking/about-gpu-cloud-networking.md): Configure GPU cluster node networking with public and private networks, routers, floating IPs, security groups, and VAST file shares.
- [InfiniBand networking](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/networking/about-infiniband.md): InfiniBand networking connects GPU cluster nodes with high bandwidth and low latency for distributed training and multi-node inference.
- [Create and manage a network](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/networking/create-and-manage-a-network.md): Create and manage Gcore Cloud networks, attach or detach network interfaces to VMs, Bare Metal, Load Balancers, and Kubernetes clusters.
- [Create and manage a subnet](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/networking/create-and-manage-a-subnetwork.md): Create and manage a subnet in a Gcore cloud network, including CIDR, DHCP, DNS, router settings, renaming, and deletion.
- [Create and manage a router](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/networking/create-and-manage-a-router.md): Create and manage a Cloud Router in Gcore, attach subnets, configure static routes, and control traffic between networks.
- [Create and configure a floating IP address](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/networking/ip-address/create-and-configure-a-floating-ip-address.md): Create, configure, reserve, assign, detach, and delete a floating IP address for Gcore Virtual Machines and Bare Metal servers.
- [Add and configure a security group](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/networking/add-and-configure-a-firewall.md): Create and manage security groups for Virtual Machines, including rules, tags, default groups, and Bare Metal servers.

## Images and SSH keys
- [Manage custom images](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/images/manage-custom-images.md): Manage Gcore Cloud custom images by viewing, renaming, tagging, deleting, and creating virtual instances from them.
- [Configure and manage SSH keys](https://docs.gcore.com/cloud/virtual-instances/connect/connect-to-your-instance-via-ssh.md): Generate, add, and manage SSH keys for Linux Virtual Instances, including deleting keys and stopping key sharing.

## Managed Kubernetes
- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/overview.md): Managed Kubernetes in GPU Cloud offers managed control planes, GPU and CPU node pools, autoscaling, storage, logging, and load balancing.
- [Create a GPU Kubernetes cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/create-a-gpu-kubernetes-cluster.md): Create a GPU Kubernetes cluster by selecting a region, version, node pools, networking, SSH key, and logging settings.

## Manage a cluster
- [Connect to a GPU Kubernetes cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/connect-to-a-gpu-kubernetes-cluster.md): Download the kubeconfig file and configure kubectl to connect to a GPU Kubernetes cluster, then list clusters and get details.
- [Manage node pools](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/manage-node-pools.md): Manage Gcore Kubernetes node pools by viewing details, scaling, replacing nodes, adding GPU pools, and deleting pools.
- [Configure cluster autoscaling](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/configure-cluster-autoscaling.md): Configure Cluster Autoscaler settings such as scan interval, expander strategy, and scale-down delays for Kubernetes node pools.
- [Configure cluster logging](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/configure-cluster-logging.md): Enable or disable cluster logging to forward container and system logs to Gcore Logging-as-a-Service for storage in OpenSearch Dashboards.
- [Configure OIDC authentication](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/configure-oidc-authentication.md): Configure and remove OIDC authentication for Kubernetes SSO using an external identity provider like Okta, Azure AD, or Keycloak.
- [Upgrade a GPU Kubernetes cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/upgrade-a-gpu-kubernetes-cluster.md): Upgrade a GPU Kubernetes cluster one minor version at a time with rolling updates, plus post-upgrade steps for autoscaler and NVIDIA plugin.
- [View cluster audit log](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/view-cluster-audit-log.md): Review an audit log of cluster operations with timestamps, action types, resources, and filters by name, type, or date range.
- [Delete a GPU Kubernetes cluster](https://docs.gcore.com/edge-ai/managed-kubernetes/delete-a-gpu-kubernetes-cluster.md): Delete a GPU Kubernetes cluster and all its nodes, pools, and control plane resources while external storage remains unaffected.
